instruction: Candid high-angle over-the-shoulder photograph of two judo practitioners sitting together on a red tatami mat. On the left, the blonde-haired man (R1) is seen from behind wearing a white gi. On the right, the dark-haired man (R2) in a white gi holds a black smartphone in front of them, displaying a selfie preview on the screen. R2's left hand rests on R1's shoulder as they both look down at the phone. Bright, even indoor lighting illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows on the vibrant red floor.
